name: Google Assistant
tagline: Your own personal Google, always ready to help whenever you need it
description: Ask questions, control smart home devices, make calls, send texts, set reminders, and get personalized assistance using natural conversational voice commands powered by Google AI.

name: Speechify
tagline: The number one text-to-speech app that reads any text aloud with natural AI voices
description: Text-to-speech platform that reads books, PDFs, articles, and documents aloud using natural-sounding AI voices. Also offers voice dictation and AI writing assistance. Trusted by over 50 million users.

name: Google Maps
tagline: Navigate your world with real-time GPS, traffic, transit, and voice-guided directions
description: Turn-by-turn voice navigation for driving, walking, cycling, and public transit. Real-time traffic data, voice search for places and businesses, and fully hands-free voice commands while navigating.

name: Shazam
tagline: Identify any song playing around you in seconds — just tap and listen
description: Music recognition app that identifies songs playing around you using your device microphone. Instantly discover song lyrics, music videos, curated playlists, and upcoming concert information for identified tracks.

name: Spotify
tagline: Music, podcasts, and audiobooks with voice search and hands-free playback controls
description: The world's largest audio streaming platform with voice-activated search and playback commands. Ask for songs, artists, moods, and genres using natural language. Works with Alexa and Google Assistant.

name: Calm
tagline: The leading app for meditation, sleep stories, and relaxation with guided voice sessions
description: Voice-guided meditation sessions, sleep stories narrated by celebrities, breathing exercises, and relaxation soundscapes. Personalized mindfulness content designed to help with stress, anxiety, and insomnia.

name: Duolingo
tagline: Learn languages for free with AI-powered speech recognition and speaking practice
description: The world's most popular language learning app with speech recognition for pronunciation feedback. Practice speaking through roleplay scenarios, flashcards, and conversation exercises from your very first lesson.

name: Seeing AI
tagline: A free Microsoft app that narrates the world around you for blind and low-vision users
description: AI-powered visual assistant by Microsoft that reads text aloud, describes photos, identifies products by barcode, recognizes people and their emotions, and narrates scenes. Supports 18+ languages. Completely free.

name: Replika
tagline: Your AI companion that listens, talks, and cares — always available via voice calls
description: AI companion app with voice messaging and real-time voice calls. Features emotional intelligence, long-term memory of your conversations, and customizable personality. Available 24/7 for voice chat whenever you need.

name: Josh.ai
tagline: Privacy-first natural language voice control designed for the luxury smart home
description: Premium smart home voice control with deep natural language understanding. Speak naturally without memorized commands to control lights, climate, entertainment, and more. Privacy-focused — no data sold to third parties.

name: AudioDiary
tagline: Just talk — AudioDiary turns your spoken thoughts into lasting AI-powered insights
description: A voice-first journal that turns spoken thoughts into lasting insights with AI analysis, custom tagging, dream analysis, and photo uploads. Encrypted and synced across devices for private reflection.

name: Letterly
tagline: Capture your voice and get polished, structured text instantly with AI rewrite presets
description: Records your voice and transforms raw speech into structured text via 27 rewrite presets — summaries, emails, LinkedIn posts, task lists. Supports 90+ languages with auto-detection and webhooks to Notion and Google Docs.

name: VOMO
tagline: Studio-grade voice recording meets AI-powered transcription and smart summaries
description: Mobile-centric voice memo tool with GPT-4o powered transcription. Generates AI meeting notes, summaries, email drafts, and action lists from voice recordings. Supports 50+ languages. Ideal for journalists and researchers.

name: Envision AI
tagline: AI-powered eyes for people who are blind or have low vision
description: Uses your smartphone camera to read text in 60+ languages, describe surroundings and objects, identify people, and detect colors — all spoken aloud. Self-voicing without needing a screen reader. Also offers Envision Glasses for wearable AI assistance.
pricing_details: Free app; Envision Glasses sold separately

name: Speech Blubs
tagline: Voice-activated speech therapy games designed for children ages one to six
description: Uses video modeling and voice-activated activities with 1,500+ speech exercises organized by themes. Created with speech therapists for early language development, speech delay, and apraxia. Available in English, Spanish, French, and Portuguese.

name: Roads Audio
tagline: Voice-first messaging designed with the blind community, built for everyone
description: An asynchronous voice messaging app designed with the blind community. Comment on specific moments in voice messages, create private voice channels, and engage without visual verification barriers like CAPTCHAs.

name: SpeechTools
tagline: Award-winning voice therapy and vocal analysis apps designed by speech therapists
description: A suite of specialized voice therapy apps including Voice Analyst for pitch and volume analysis with telehealth, Christella VoiceUp for voice feminization, and DAF PRO for delayed auditory feedback fluency training.

name: Waze
tagline: Community-driven GPS navigation with real-time traffic alerts and custom voice packs
description: Social navigation app with voice-guided directions, real-time traffic reporting by community members, and customizable celebrity voice packs. Users can even record their own voice for navigation prompts.

name: SoundHound
tagline: Voice AI that identifies music by singing or humming and answers your questions
description: Identify songs by singing or humming a melody, then use conversational voice AI to search across dozens of knowledge domains including weather, sports, stocks, restaurants, and more.

name: Wondercraft
tagline: Create podcasts, audio ads, and narrations with AI — no recording studio needed
description: An AI-powered audio creation platform that generates podcasts, audiobooks, ad narrations, and sales content from text. Features voice cloning, 40+ premium voices, a music library with 200+ tracks, and a video editor.

name: ChatGPT
tagline: Talk to ChatGPT with Advanced Voice Mode for natural, real-time AI conversations
description: OpenAI's conversational AI with Advanced Voice Mode that lets you have natural spoken conversations, ask questions, brainstorm ideas, and get help with tasks using your voice in real time.

name: Vapi
tagline: Build, test, and deploy advanced voice AI agents for phone and web in minutes
description: A developer platform for creating voice AI agents with orchestration across STT, LLM, and TTS providers. Supports phone calls, web, and mobile integration. Used for customer service, appointment booking, and sales automation.

name: Hume AI
tagline: The empathic voice interface — voice AI that understands and responds to human emotions
description: A developer platform for building voice AI that understands and responds to human emotions. The Empathic Voice Interface detects tone, sentiment, and emotional cues in real-time for building conversational AI applications with emotional intelligence.

name: Otter.ai
tagline: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings in real time
description: Automated meeting notes with real-time transcription, speaker identification, and AI-generated summaries. Integrates with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams for seamless workflow.

name: Be My Eyes
tagline: Connecting blind and low-vision people with volunteers and AI for visual assistance
description: Free app connecting visually impaired users to sighted volunteers via live video calls. Includes Be My AI powered by GPT-4 for instant image descriptions available in over 36 languages worldwide.

name: Nomi AI
tagline: AI companion with human-level long-term memory and expressive voice messages
description: Create multiple AI companions each with unique personality, look, and backstory. Features real-time voice messages with tone and cadence that vary with emotions, group chats between Nomis, and genuine long-term memory that evolves with you.

name: Wispr Flow
tagline: AI-powered voice dictation that works everywhere, four times faster than typing
description: AI-powered voice dictation app that works in any application on your device. Supports over 100 languages, auto-edits text for grammar and formatting, and includes command mode for hands-free editing.

name: Amazon Alexa
tagline: The voice assistant that controls your smart home, answers questions, and automates your life
description: Set up Alexa-enabled devices, manage smart home gadgets, play music, get news updates, create shopping lists, and control thousands of compatible devices with your voice. Amazon Alexa is one of the most widely used voice assistants in the world.

name: Headspace
tagline: Guided meditation and mindfulness for better sleep, focus, and everyday wellness
description: Voice-guided meditation sessions, sleep content, focus music, and mindfulness exercises led by expert instructors. Features personalized recommendations based on your goals and detailed progress tracking.

name: Voice Dream Reader
tagline: Premium text-to-speech reader for books, PDFs, articles, and web pages
description: Advanced text-to-speech app with over 100 premium natural-sounding voices. Reads books, PDFs, web articles, and documents aloud with adjustable speed, pronunciation controls, and highlighting. Popular with accessibility users.

name: Google Home
tagline: Control your entire smart home with voice commands through Google Assistant
description: Manage over 50,000 smart home devices including lights, thermostats, cameras, and appliances. Voice control via Google Assistant, create automation routines, and manage your entire household from one app.

name: Willow Voice
tagline: YC-backed voice dictation with 40% better accuracy than built-in tools
description: Dictation app with significantly better accuracy than built-in tools, working under one second. Supports 100+ languages system-wide across apps. Learns your writing style and custom vocabulary over time.

name: BoldVoice
tagline: Speak English clearly with Hollywood accent coaches and real-time AI pronunciation feedback
description: An accent training app combining video lessons from Hollywood accent coaches with real-time AI pronunciation feedback at the sound level. Used by 5M+ people in 150+ countries with personalized plans based on your native language.

name: Fish Audio
tagline: Clone any voice from just 10 seconds of audio with studio-grade AI text-to-speech
description: Clone any voice from just 10 seconds of audio — significantly faster than competitors requiring 60+ seconds. Over 2 million community voices in 8 languages with cross-language capability. Roughly 45% cheaper than ElevenLabs.
pricing_details: Free tier; Premium with commercial licensing

name: Apple Siri
tagline: Apple's built-in voice assistant with deep device integration and Apple Intelligence
description: Apple's voice assistant available across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and HomePod. Handles tasks like sending messages, setting reminders, controlling smart home devices, and answering questions with deep on-device integration and privacy-focused processing.

name: Microsoft Copilot
tagline: AI companion that works across Windows, Office, Edge, and your daily workflows
description: Microsoft's AI assistant embedded across the entire Microsoft ecosystem. Use voice to draft documents, analyze data in Excel, create presentations, summarize emails in Outlook, and get answers from the web — all through natural conversation.

name: Speak
tagline: AI-powered English speaking tutor with unlimited conversation practice
description: Language learning app focused on speaking practice with AI tutors. Features unlimited conversation practice, pronunciation feedback, and personalized lessons. Built specifically for learning English through speaking rather than memorization.

name: Fireflies.ai
tagline: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes conversations across platforms
description: Automatically joins and records meetings on Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and more. Provides AI-generated transcripts in 60+ languages, smart summaries, action items, and searchable conversation intelligence. Integrates with CRM and project management tools.

name: Krisp
tagline: AI noise cancellation and meeting transcription that works with any communication app
description: Removes background noise, voices, and echoes in real-time during calls on any communication app. Also provides AI meeting transcription, notes, and summaries. Used by call centers and remote teams for crystal-clear audio.

name: Sonix
tagline: Automated transcription with 99% accuracy in 49 languages and powerful editing tools
description: Upload audio or video files for fast, accurate automated transcription in 49 languages. Features include speaker labeling, word-level timestamps, translation, subtitles, and integrations with Dropbox, Zoom, Salesforce, and Adobe Premiere.

name: SuperWhisper
tagline: On-device AI dictation that never sends your voice data to the cloud
description: Privacy-first dictation app that processes all speech locally on your device using OpenAI Whisper models. Works across all macOS apps with zero cloud dependency. Supports 100+ languages with fast, accurate transcription.

name: Aqua Voice
tagline: Dictation that transforms messy speech into polished, publication-ready prose
description: An AI dictation tool that goes beyond simple transcription — it transforms raw spoken words into polished, well-structured text with proper punctuation, formatting, and natural flow. Designed for writers, professionals, and content creators.

name: Voicy
tagline: Voice typing with 99%+ accuracy in 50+ languages across all your apps
description: System-wide voice typing app with over 99% accuracy in 50+ languages. Works across Mac, Windows, and all your favorite apps. Features custom vocabulary, voice commands for formatting, and real-time transcription.

name: tl;dv
tagline: Free unlimited meeting recording with AI notes, summaries, and multi-meeting intelligence
description: Records and transcribes meetings on Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams with unlimited free recording. AI generates summaries, action items, and key moments. Supports 40+ languages with translation and multi-meeting intelligence for tracking themes across conversations.

name: Transkriptor
tagline: AI transcription in 100+ languages for meetings, lectures, and interviews
description: Transcribes audio and video in 100+ languages with AI-powered accuracy. Supports real-time meeting transcription, file uploads, and YouTube URL imports. Generates summaries, action items, and exports to multiple formats.

name: Happy Scribe
tagline: AI and human transcription and subtitling in 120+ languages
description: Offers both AI-powered and human-made transcription and subtitling in 120+ languages. Used by BBC, Forbes, and Spotify for accurate audio-to-text conversion. Features include speaker identification, timestamps, and export to SRT, VTT, and Word.

name: Descript
tagline: AI-powered video and podcast editing where you edit media by editing text
description: Revolutionary editing tool that lets you edit audio and video by editing a text transcript. Features include AI voice cloning (Overdub), filler word removal, Studio Sound for audio enhancement, and AI-generated summaries and show notes for podcasts.

name: Udio
tagline: AI music creation with granular control for professional-quality song generation
description: AI music generation platform built by ex-Spotify researchers. Create songs with vocals, choose genres and moods, and fine-tune outputs with granular controls. Offers more professional-grade control than competitors for serious music producers.

name: Adobe Podcast
tagline: AI-powered audio recording that enhances any voice to studio quality
description: Web-based audio recording and editing tool from Adobe. The Enhanced Speech feature removes background noise and improves audio quality to sound like it was recorded in a professional studio. Includes transcription and editing tools.

name: PlayHT
tagline: Ultra-realistic AI voice generation for podcasts, audiobooks, and content creation
description: Generate hyper-realistic speech from text with 800+ AI voices in 142 languages. Features voice cloning, emotion control, SSML support, and API access. Popular for creating audiobooks, podcasts, and long-form audio content.

name: Podcastle
tagline: All-in-one podcast creation studio with 1,000+ AI voices and magic editing
description: End-to-end podcast creation platform with AI-powered recording, editing, and hosting. Features 1,000+ lifelike TTS voices, background noise removal, auto-leveling, and one-click publishing to all major podcast platforms.

name: Recall.ai
tagline: Universal meeting bot API for recording and transcribing across all platforms
description: Developer API for building meeting bots that join Zoom, Teams, Meet, and other platforms to record and transcribe. Handles bot lifecycle management, real-time transcription, and audio/video capture. Used by meeting intelligence startups.

name: Suno
tagline: Create full songs with vocals, instruments, and lyrics from a simple text prompt
description: AI music generator that creates complete songs — vocals, instruments, and lyrics — from text descriptions. Describe a mood, genre, or topic and get a professionally produced track in seconds. Used by millions of creators worldwide.

name: NaturalReader
tagline: Listen to documents, PDFs, ebooks, and web pages with human-like AI voices
description: Cloud-based text-to-speech that reads Word docs, PDFs, ebooks, and web pages aloud with natural-sounding voices. Supports 20+ languages with adjustable speed. Available as web app, Chrome extension, and mobile app.

name: LOVO (Genny)
tagline: 500+ AI voices in 100 languages with 30+ emotional tones for content creation
description: AI voice generator with 500+ voices across 100+ languages and 30+ emotional tones. Create voiceovers for videos, e-learning, marketing, and more. Features include voice cloning, script writing, and a built-in video editor.

name: LALAL.AI
tagline: AI-powered vocal and instrumental track separation with studio-grade quality
description: Separate vocals, drums, bass, guitar, and other instruments from any song using AI. Used by music producers, DJs, and karaoke enthusiasts. Supports batch processing and multiple output formats with high-fidelity results.

name: ELSA Speak
tagline: AI speech coach that analyzes your pronunciation in real-time for perfect English
description: AI-powered English pronunciation coach that listens to your speech and provides instant feedback at the sound level. Identifies specific pronunciation issues, tracks improvement over time, and creates personalized lessons based on your native language.

name: Youper
tagline: AI-powered emotional health assistant with personalized therapy techniques
description: Mental health app that uses AI to deliver personalized therapy techniques based on your emotional state. Features voice-driven mood tracking, CBT exercises, guided meditations, and health monitoring. Recommended by psychologists and psychiatrists.

name: Wysa
tagline: AI mental health companion with evidence-based tools for anxiety, stress, and sleep
description: Clinically validated AI wellness companion that provides CBT, DBT, and mindfulness-based tools for managing anxiety, depression, and stress. Features voice-based mood check-ins, guided exercises, and optional human therapist access.

name: Ello
tagline: AI reading assistant that listens to children read and provides gentle guidance
description: An AI-powered reading companion for children ages 5-11. Uses proprietary speech recognition to listen as kids read physical books aloud, gently correcting pronunciation and building confidence. Adapts to each child's reading level.

name: Yoodli
tagline: Private AI speech coach for interviews, presentations, and difficult conversations
description: AI communication coach providing real-time feedback on filler words, pacing, eye contact, and clarity. Practice mock interviews, sales pitches, and presentations with AI roleplay partners. All data processed privately — no human reviewers.

name: Langua
tagline: Practice real conversations with AI voices cloned from native speakers
description: Language learning app focused on conversational practice using AI voices cloned from native speakers. Features Call Mode for hands-free conversation practice, grammar correction, and vocabulary building through natural dialogue in 20+ languages.

name: Google Live Transcribe
tagline: Real-time speech-to-text transcription for deaf and hard of hearing users
description: Free accessibility app that provides real-time transcription of speech and sounds for deaf and hard of hearing users. Supports 80+ languages, shows sound events like doorbells and alarms, and allows two-way conversation via typed responses.

name: Ava
tagline: 24/7 live captions for deaf and hard of hearing people in any conversation
description: Provides real-time captions for in-person and virtual conversations. Uses AI combined with optional professional captioners for 99% accuracy. Shows who is speaking with color-coded transcripts. Works for meetings, classes, and daily life.

name: Amazon Echo (Alexa App)
tagline: The companion app for all Echo and Alexa-enabled devices in your home
description: Manage your Echo devices, smart home gadgets, routines, and Alexa skills. Set up voice-controlled automations, create groups of devices, manage family features, and access the full Alexa experience from your phone.

name: Clubhouse
tagline: Voice-first social network for live audio conversations and group voice chats
description: The pioneering voice-based social app, now pivoted to voice messaging with Chats — voice-only group conversations combining the intimacy of voice notes with the convenience of group texts. Join live audio rooms or send async voice messages.

name: Telegram
tagline: Secure messaging with voice chats, video calls, and live audio broadcasts
description: Privacy-focused messaging app with robust voice features including group voice chats supporting thousands of listeners, voice messages with waveform visualization, real-time voice translation, and video calls with screen sharing.

name: Home Assistant
tagline: Open-source smart home platform with powerful local voice control and AI integration
description: The leading open-source smart home platform supporting 2,000+ integrations. Features local voice control with custom wake words, LLM integration for natural language commands, and automation without cloud dependency. Privacy-focused and community-driven.

name: Sonos
tagline: Premium whole-home audio system with built-in voice control
description: Control your Sonos speaker system with voice commands. Play music, adjust volume, group rooms, and manage your audio experience hands-free. Works with Alexa and Google Assistant for seamless smart home integration.

name: Discord
tagline: Voice, video, and text chat platform for communities with AI-powered features
description: The go-to platform for voice chat in gaming and communities. Features high-quality voice channels, Stage Channels for audio events, noise suppression, spatial audio, and AI-powered features like chat summaries and conversation topics.

name: Voicemod
tagline: Real-time AI voice changer with 200+ voices for gaming, streaming, and calls
description: Transform your voice in real-time with 200+ AI voice effects and character voices. Works in Discord, Zoom, Twitch, and games. Features a soundboard, voice cloning, and custom voice creation. Ultra-low latency for natural conversations.

name: Apple Maps
tagline: Voice-guided navigation with Siri integration for hands-free turn-by-turn directions
description: Apple's built-in maps and navigation app with deep Siri voice integration. Get turn-by-turn voice guidance for driving, walking, cycling, and transit. Ask Siri for directions, nearby places, and ETA updates completely hands-free.

name: TripIt
tagline: Organize all your travel plans in one place with voice-accessible itineraries
description: Automatically creates detailed trip itineraries from confirmation emails. Features voice-accessible schedules via Siri and Google Assistant, real-time flight alerts, terminal maps, and seat tracking. Used by millions of travelers worldwide.

name: PayPal
tagline: Send and receive money with voice commands through Siri and Google Assistant
description: PayPal supports voice-initiated payments and money transfers through Siri and Google Assistant. Ask to send money to contacts, check your balance, or review recent transactions — all through natural voice commands.

name: Robinhood
tagline: Commission-free trading with voice-accessible stock quotes and portfolio updates
description: Commission-free stock, ETF, options, and crypto trading app. Supports voice queries through device assistants for checking stock prices, portfolio performance, and market news. Features clean interface designed for mobile-first investing.

name: Deepgram
tagline: Enterprise voice AI platform with industry-leading speech recognition and synthesis
description: Voice AI platform offering speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent capabilities. The Nova-2 model delivers industry-leading accuracy and speed for real-time transcription. Used by enterprises for call centers, meeting intelligence, and voice apps.

name: Voiceflow
tagline: Design, prototype, and launch voice and chat AI agents without writing code
description: No-code platform for designing conversational AI agents for voice and chat. Build Alexa skills, Google Actions, web chatbots, and phone agents with a visual canvas. Features collaboration tools, testing, analytics, and one-click deployment.

name: Walmart Voice Order
tagline: Reorder groceries and essentials by voice through Google Assistant and Siri
description: Order groceries and everyday items using voice commands through Google Assistant and Siri. Walmart's AI assistant Sparky helps with voice-based reordering of past purchases, subscription management, and product search.

name: AssemblyAI
tagline: Modern speech recognition API with best-in-class accuracy and developer experience
description: AI speech-to-text API built for developers. Features include real-time streaming transcription, speaker diarization, sentiment analysis, content moderation, and PII redaction. The Universal-2 model supports 20+ languages with top accuracy.

name: LiveKit
tagline: Open-source real-time media platform for building voice and video AI agents
description: Open-source WebRTC platform for building real-time voice and video applications. Features sub-100ms latency, AI voice agent framework, scalable infrastructure, and SDKs for every platform. Used by startups and enterprises for live voice AI.

name: Retell AI
tagline: Build production-ready AI voice agents with human-like conversation in minutes
description: Developer platform for creating voice AI agents that handle phone calls, schedule appointments, and navigate IVR systems. Features 600ms response time, 99.99% uptime, and integrations with telephony providers, CRMs, and calendars.

name: Synthflow
tagline: No-code AI voice agent builder with drag-and-drop simplicity
description: Build AI voice agents without writing code using a visual drag-and-drop builder. Create phone bots for customer service, appointment booking, and lead qualification. Integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, and major CRM platforms.

name: Google Gemini
tagline: Google's most capable AI with natural voice conversations and multimodal understanding
description: Google's advanced AI assistant replacing Google Assistant for complex tasks. Features natural voice conversations, image understanding, code generation, and deep integration with Google Workspace. Handles multi-step requests with reasoning.

name: Perplexity AI
tagline: AI-powered answer engine with voice search that cites real sources
description: AI search and answer engine that provides cited, real-time answers to complex questions. Features voice search for hands-free queries, follow-up questions, and source verification. Combines LLM reasoning with live web search.

name: Todoist
tagline: Task manager with natural language voice input and smart assistant integrations
description: Leading task management app with natural language input for creating tasks by voice. Works with Siri, Google Assistant, and Alexa for hands-free task creation. Understands dates, priorities, and projects from natural speech.

name: Cartesia
tagline: Fastest and most realistic real-time voice AI API with sub-100ms latency
description: Voice AI API delivering the fastest and most realistic speech synthesis with sub-100ms time-to-first-audio. Features Sonic model for lifelike TTS, voice cloning, emotion control, and streaming capabilities for building real-time voice applications.

name: Claude
tagline: Anthropic's AI assistant with natural voice mode for thoughtful, nuanced conversations
description: Anthropic's conversational AI with advanced reasoning, analysis, and creative capabilities. Features a voice mode for natural spoken conversations, long-context understanding, and careful, nuanced responses. Trusted for research, writing, and coding.

name: Notion AI
tagline: AI-powered workspace with voice input for notes, docs, and project management
description: All-in-one workspace combining notes, docs, wikis, and project management with AI features. Use voice dictation to capture thoughts, ask Notion AI to summarize, translate, or rewrite content, and manage tasks hands-free.

name: Google Translate
tagline: Instant voice-to-voice translation in 133 languages with conversation mode
description: Google's translation app with real-time voice-to-voice conversation mode. Speak in one language and hear the translation spoken aloud instantly. Supports 133 languages, offline translation for 59 languages, and camera translation for signs and menus.

name: SayHi Translate
tagline: Instant voice-to-voice translation for face-to-face conversations
description: Hold a conversation in two languages with instant voice translation. Speak naturally and hear translations in real-time. Supports 90+ languages and dialects with male and female voice options. Simple, clean interface designed for quick conversations.

name: Gong
tagline: Revenue intelligence platform that captures and analyzes every sales conversation
description: Enterprise revenue intelligence platform that records and analyzes sales calls, emails, and meetings. AI identifies winning patterns, deal risks, and coaching opportunities. Trusted by thousands of sales teams for pipeline visibility and forecasting.

name: Rabbit R1
tagline: Standalone AI device with voice-first interface that completes tasks for you
description: A pocket-sized AI device with a push-to-talk button and conversational interface. Uses a Large Action Model to complete tasks like booking rides, ordering food, and playing music through voice commands without needing a phone.

name: Cognigy
tagline: Enterprise conversational AI platform for voice and chat customer service at scale
description: Enterprise-grade conversational AI connecting voice and chat channels with back-end systems like SAP, ServiceNow, and Salesforce. Powers AI agents for Fortune 500 companies across multiple languages with seamless human handoff.

name: Pi by Inflection
tagline: A personal AI that's designed to be kind, curious, and a great conversationalist
description: Personal AI companion designed for natural, empathetic voice conversations. Features a warm, supportive personality with real-time voice mode. Great for brainstorming, venting, learning, and exploring ideas through spoken dialogue.

name: PolyAI
tagline: Voice-first customer service AI that resolves over 80% of calls autonomously
description: Enterprise conversational AI for contact centers that handles customer calls in 45 languages. Achieves over 80% call containment with natural conversation flow. Used by major brands for order management, billing, and support with 2,000+ live implementations.

name: Nuance Gatekeeper
tagline: Voice biometric authentication that verifies identity in seconds during natural speech
description: Enterprise voice biometric platform that authenticates callers using their unique voiceprint during natural conversation. Eliminates PINs and security questions with passive voice verification. Detects synthetic and recorded voice fraud attempts.

name: Rosetta Stone
tagline: Immersive language learning with patented TruAccent speech recognition technology
description: The gold standard in language learning with patented TruAccent speech recognition that compares your pronunciation to native speakers. Learn 25 languages through immersive lessons, live tutoring, and on-the-go practice with instant feedback.

name: Inworld AI
tagline: Voice AI powering intelligent NPCs with real-time personality and memory in games
description: Enterprise AI platform creating intelligent game characters that respond to voice with unique personalities, emotions, and memories. Powers NPCs for Ubisoft, Xbox, and Disney with real-time voice interaction and contextual dialogue.

name: Ada Health
tagline: AI-powered health assessment through conversational symptom checking
description: AI health companion that guides you through symptom assessment via conversational interface. Ask about symptoms by voice, get personalized health information, and understand possible conditions. Used by 13M+ people with clinically validated accuracy.

name: Alexa Shopping

description: Shop on Amazon entirely by voice through Alexa. Add items to cart, reorder past purchases, track deliveries, compare prices, and get personalized product recommendations. Rufus AI provides voice-guided product discovery.

name: Voice.ai
tagline: Free real-time voice changer with lifelike AI voice effects for any PC app
description: Transform your voice in real-time on any PC application with lifelike AI voice effects. Works with games, streaming platforms, and communication apps. Features a growing library of voice skins and community-created voices. Completely free to use.

name: Altered AI
tagline: Professional voice changer and AI voice studio for content creators
description: Professional-grade real-time voice changer and AI voice creation studio. Transform your voice into any character or persona with high-fidelity output. Used by content creators, game developers, and studios for voice production and dubbing.

name: Snips (Sonos Voice Control)
tagline: Privacy-first on-device voice AI for smart home control
description: On-device voice assistant technology that processes all commands locally without sending data to the cloud. Originally an independent company, now powering Sonos Voice Control. Demonstrates that voice AI can be fully privacy-preserving.

name: Mint (Credit Karma)
tagline: AI-powered financial tracking with voice-accessible spending insights
description: Personal finance app providing credit monitoring, spending insights, and financial recommendations. Access your financial snapshot through voice assistants, get spending alerts, and track bills. Now part of Credit Karma's financial platform.

name: Replica Studios
tagline: AI voice actors for games, film, and animation with expressive character voices
description: Create expressive character voices for games, animations, and creative projects. Features a library of AI voice actors with emotional range, custom voice creation, and real-time voice generation. Used by indie and AAA game studios.

name: Grammarly
tagline: AI writing assistant with voice dictation for clear, effective communication
description: AI-powered writing assistant that works across apps and browsers. Features voice dictation for composing emails, documents, and messages. Checks grammar, tone, clarity, and style in real-time. Used by 30M+ daily users for professional communication.

name: Lindy AI
tagline: Build custom AI voice agents and automations without code in minutes
description: Highly flexible AI agent platform for creating custom voice assistants, phone agents, and workflow automations. Features no-code builder, 200+ integrations, and the ability to create agents that call, email, schedule, and manage tasks autonomously.

name: Coqui TTS
tagline: Open-source text-to-speech and voice cloning toolkit for developers
description: Open-source deep learning toolkit for text-to-speech and voice cloning. The XTTS v2 model supports multilingual voice cloning from short audio samples. Community-driven with extensive documentation and model zoo.

name: Whisper Memos
tagline: Record a voice memo and get a neatly written email with the key points every morning
description: Simple app that lets you record voice memos throughout the day. Whisper AI transcribes them and delivers a neatly organized email summary each morning with key points extracted and formatted. Perfect for capturing ideas on the go.

name: Glean
tagline: AI-powered enterprise search with voice queries across all your company's knowledge
description: Enterprise AI search platform that connects to 100+ data sources. Ask questions in natural language across Slack, Drive, Confluence, Jira, and more. AI understands context and permissions to deliver relevant answers from company knowledge.

name: Rev.ai
tagline: Affordable speech-to-text API with language detection starting at $0.02 per minute
description: Speech recognition API offering both async and real-time transcription with automatic language detection and sentiment analysis. Known for affordability starting at $0.02/min. Supports custom vocabularies and speaker diarization.

name: Otter AI Chat
tagline: Ask questions about your meetings and get instant AI-powered answers
description: An AI chatbot built on top of Otter.ai's meeting transcriptions. Ask questions about past meetings and get instant answers with citations from the transcript. Cross-reference multiple meetings and extract insights from your conversation history.

name: Moshi by Kyutai
tagline: Open-source voice AI with real-time full-duplex conversation capabilities
description: Open-source speech-to-speech AI model from French research lab Kyutai. Features full-duplex conversation (can listen and speak simultaneously), emotional expression, and real-time interaction without intermediate text transcription.

name: Audiopen
tagline: Turn messy voice notes into clear, structured text with AI in seconds
description: Ramble into your phone and Audiopen transforms your messy thoughts into clear, polished text. Choose from different output styles — summary, blog post, email, social media post. Supports 18 languages and integrates with Notion, Obsidian, and Zapier.

name: Limitless (Pendant)
tagline: Wearable AI pendant that remembers every conversation and meeting for you
description: AI-powered wearable pendant that captures conversations throughout your day. Provides personalized AI powered by everything you've seen, said, and heard. Features meeting prep, action item extraction, and consent-focused privacy design.

name: Picovoice
tagline: On-device voice AI with custom wake words, speech recognition, and NLU
description: End-to-end on-device voice AI platform. Build custom wake words, speech-to-text, and natural language understanding that run entirely on-device without internet. Privacy-first with support for embedded, mobile, and desktop platforms.

name: Mycroft (Open Assistant)
tagline: Open-source voice assistant you can run on your own hardware with full privacy
description: Community-driven open-source voice assistant that runs on Raspberry Pi, Linux, and other hardware. Full privacy with local processing, customizable skills, and no corporate data collection. The open alternative to Alexa and Google Assistant.

name: Voiceitt
tagline: Voice AI for people with non-standard speech from cerebral palsy, ALS, or stroke
description: Inclusive voice technology that recognizes non-standard speech patterns caused by conditions like cerebral palsy, ALS, Down syndrome, and stroke. Translates unique speech into clear output for communication with smart devices, caregivers, and friends.

name: Samsung Bixby
tagline: Samsung's intelligent assistant for Galaxy devices with deep system-level control
description: Samsung's built-in voice assistant for Galaxy phones, tablets, watches, and TVs. Controls device settings, launches apps, composes messages, and manages smart home devices with natural language commands and deep Samsung ecosystem integration.

name: Dragon Anywhere
tagline: Professional-grade mobile dictation with 99% accuracy from Nuance
description: Nuance's premium dictation app delivers 99% accuracy for professional use. Create and edit documents of any length by voice, add custom words and commands, and sync documents across devices. Trusted by medical, legal, and business professionals.

name: Notta
tagline: Fast AI transcription in 58 languages with real-time bilingual note-taking
description: Transcribes audio and video in 58 languages with bilingual real-time transcription. Auto-translates into 50+ languages. Records meetings, imports audio files, and generates AI summaries. Used by 8M+ people for meetings, interviews, and lectures.

name: Jamie
tagline: Bot-free AI meeting notes — no bots join your calls, just accurate transcription
description: AI meeting note-taker that captures computer audio directly without joining meetings as a bot. Works across Zoom, Teams, Meet, and any other platform. Generates summaries, action items, and decisions from every conversation.

name: ElevenLabs
tagline: Industry-leading AI voice generation with 1,000+ voices in 29 languages
description: The gold standard in AI voice synthesis. Generate ultra-realistic speech from text with 1,000+ voices across 29+ languages. Features include voice cloning from 60 seconds of audio, AI dubbing, voice library marketplace, and podcast creation tools.

name: Murf AI
tagline: Studio-quality AI voiceovers for videos, presentations, and e-learning content
description: Create professional voiceovers with 200+ natural-sounding AI voices in 20+ languages. Features include voice cloning, accent selection, emphasis and pitch controls, and built-in video editor. Popular for e-learning, marketing, and corporate presentations.

name: Woebot
tagline: AI-powered mental health chatbot using CBT principles with voice interaction
description: Clinically researched AI chatbot that uses Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) principles to help users manage stress, anxiety, and depression. Offers guided conversations, mood tracking, and evidence-based therapeutic techniques.

name: Orai
tagline: AI public speaking coach that analyzes your pacing, energy, and clarity in real-time
description: Practice and improve your public speaking with AI-powered feedback on pacing, energy, clarity, use of filler words, and facial expressions. Features practice scenarios, progress tracking, and personalized coaching tips.

name: Pimsleur
tagline: Learn to speak 51 languages through scientifically proven audio-based lessons
description: Audio-first language learning method based on spaced repetition and core vocabulary. Learn by listening and speaking, not reading. Features 51 languages with voice recognition for pronunciation feedback, driving mode, and offline access.

name: InnoCaption
tagline: Free real-time captioning for phone calls for people who are deaf or hard of hearing
description: FCC-certified captioning app that displays real-time captions during phone calls for people who are deaf or hard of hearing. Completely free for qualifying users in the US. Works with any phone number using AI and human captioners.

name: Marco Polo
tagline: Video and voice messaging app for staying close with the people who matter most
description: Asynchronous video and voice messaging app designed for close friends and family. Send video or voice messages that play like a personal conversation. Features groups, reactions, and a private, ad-free experience focused on meaningful connection.

name: Riverside
tagline: Studio-quality remote podcast and video recording with AI editing tools
description: Record studio-quality audio and video remotely with local recording technology. AI features include text-based editing, automated transcriptions in 100+ languages, magic clips for social media, and speaker detection.

name: Kits AI
tagline: AI voice tools for musicians — train custom voice models from your own audio
description: Music-focused AI platform that lets artists train custom voice models from their own vocals. Create AI covers, transform vocals across styles, and separate stems. Features artist partnerships and royalty-free voice models.

name: Venmo
tagline: Send and request money socially with Siri voice command integration
description: Social payments app that lets you split bills, pay friends, and shop at millions of businesses. Supports Siri Shortcuts for voice-initiated payments — say 'Hey Siri, send $20 to Alex on Venmo' for hands-free money transfers.

name: Serenade
tagline: Open-source speech-to-code engine — write code by speaking naturally
description: Write code using your voice with natural speech commands. Supports Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, and more across VS Code, JetBrains, and other editors. Open-source speech-to-code engine designed specifically for developers.

name: Character.AI
tagline: Chat and voice call with millions of AI characters — from historical figures to custom creations
description: Create and interact with AI characters through text and voice calls. Chat with AI versions of historical figures, fictional characters, language tutors, and custom personalities. Features voice calls for natural spoken conversations with any character.

name: Babbel
tagline: Language learning with speech recognition for real-world conversational practice
description: Language learning app offering 14 languages with speech recognition technology for pronunciation practice. Courses designed by linguists focus on real-world conversations. Features review sessions, cultural notes, and offline access.

name: Capital One
tagline: Manage your finances by voice with Eno, Capital One's AI-powered assistant
description: Capital One's banking app features Eno, an AI assistant you can talk to for checking balances, reviewing transactions, paying bills, and getting spending insights. Also supports voice banking through Alexa and Google Assistant.

name: Resemble AI
tagline: Custom AI voice cloning and generation from just 5 minutes of audio
description: Enterprise voice AI platform for creating custom voice clones from minimal audio samples. Features real-time voice synthesis, emotion control, cross-language support, and deepfake detection. Used for gaming, entertainment, and accessibility.

name: Bland AI
tagline: Developer-first AI phone calling platform for enterprise-scale voice automation
description: Build and deploy AI agents that make and receive phone calls at enterprise scale. Features custom fine-tuned models, dedicated infrastructure, and sub-second response times. Used for sales, customer service, and appointment scheduling.

name: iTranslate
tagline: Voice and text translation in 100+ languages with offline support
description: Translate conversations in real-time with voice-to-voice translation. Supports 100+ languages with voice input and output. Features include offline mode, camera translation, dictionary, and phrasebook for travelers.

name: Dialpad
tagline: AI-native business communications with real-time transcription and coaching
description: Cloud communications platform with built-in AI for real-time call transcription, sentiment analysis, automated notes, and live agent coaching. Unifies phone, video, messaging, and contact center in one AI-powered platform.

name: WellSaid Labs
tagline: Enterprise AI voice generation with authentic regional accents and dialects
description: Enterprise-focused AI voice platform with 50+ studio-quality voices across multiple languages and regional dialects including Arabic, Turkish, and Persian. Designed for creating localized content at scale for corporations and media companies.

name: Speechling
tagline: Free language speaking practice with feedback from real human coaches
description: Practice speaking in 14 languages with unlimited free recordings. Each submission receives feedback from native-speaking coaches within 24 hours. Combines AI speech recognition with human coaching for targeted pronunciation improvement.

name: Just Press Record
tagline: One-tap voice recording with instant transcription across all Apple devices
description: Elegant voice recording app for Apple ecosystem with one-tap recording from iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad, and Mac. Features instant transcription, iCloud sync across devices, and search within transcripts. Perfect for capturing voice memos on the go.

name: Sesame (by ex-Googlers)
tagline: Voice AI research focused on creating the most human-like conversational experience
description: Voice AI company by former Google researchers building the next generation of conversational AI. Known for ultra-natural voice interactions with emotional understanding, turn-taking, and personality. Demos have gone viral for their human-like quality.

name: Speechmatics
tagline: The most accurate and inclusive speech recognition API supporting all major languages
description: Enterprise speech recognition API known for accuracy across accents, dialects, and demographics. Supports real-time and batch transcription in 50+ languages. Features include speaker diarization, sentiment analysis, and custom vocabulary.

name: Kore.ai
tagline: Enterprise conversational AI platform for building virtual assistants at scale
description: Enterprise platform for building AI-powered virtual assistants across voice and digital channels. Features no-code bot builder, pre-built industry templates, and integration with 75+ enterprise systems. Serves banking, healthcare, and retail.

name: Flo Health
tagline: AI-powered women's health app with voice-enabled cycle tracking and insights
description: Leading women's health app with AI-powered cycle predictions, personalized health insights, and symptom tracking. Features voice logging for quick period and symptom entry, AI health assistant, and content from 100+ medical experts.

name: Whisper (OpenAI)
tagline: Open-source speech recognition supporting 99 languages with remarkable accuracy
description: OpenAI's open-source automatic speech recognition model trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual data. Runs locally with zero per-minute cost. Supports 99 languages with translation capabilities. Used as the backbone for many voice AI apps.

name: Aiko
tagline: On-device transcription for iPhone and Mac — fast, private, and accurate
description: Lightweight transcription app that runs entirely on-device using Apple's native speech recognition. Record or import audio files for quick, private transcription. No internet required, no data leaves your device. Supports 100+ languages.

name: Plaud.ai
tagline: AI voice recorder hardware with ChatGPT-powered transcription and summaries
description: Ultra-thin AI voice recorder device that pairs with a mobile app. Records conversations, phone calls, and meetings, then uses GPT-4 to transcribe and generate summaries, mind maps, and action items. MagSafe compatible for iPhone.
